title: COLLEGE OVERVIEW
content: Annasaheb Dange College of Engineering and Technology (ADCET), Ashta is a college of engineering and technology located at Ashta, Dist. Sangli, Maharashtra - 416301.

title: COLLEGE OVERVIEW
content: ADCET is run by Sant Dnyaneshwar Shikshan Sanstha.

title: COLLEGE OVERVIEW
content: ADCET was established in the year 1999.

title: COLLEGE OVERVIEW
content: ADCET is an Empowered Autonomous Institute affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur, Maharashtra.

title: COLLEGE OVERVIEW
content: ADCET is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi.

title: COLLEGE OVERVIEW
content: ADCET is one of the prominent institutions of higher technical education in Western Maharashtra.

title: COLLEGE OVERVIEW
content: The institute is committed to producing professionally competent engineers who can contribute meaningfully to society and nation building.

title: COLLEGE OVERVIEW
content: The ADCET campus is spread across more than 25 acres in Ashta, Sangli.

title: COLLEGE OVERVIEW
content: The college has more than 3000 students.

title: COLLEGE OVERVIEW
